stem_book: A thin uniform semi-circular plate and a semi-circular ring of same mass and radius R are joined as shown (plate forms the lower half, ring the upper half, the X-axis touching the plate at O). The y-coordinate of the centre of mass of the system w.r.t. the shown coordinate system is (a) R(1 + 1/(3π)) (b) R(1 − 1/(3π)) (c) R(π + 1/(3π)) (d) R
work: plate at R − 4R/(3π), ring at R + 2R/π, equal masses ⇒ y = R + (2R/π − 4R/(3π))/2 = R(1 + 1/(3π))
